reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Optical/reporter deconvolution, target-product initial rates and substrate-by-compound kinetic matrix.

checks.reason: No pre-execution consultation of primary target/reporter assay Methods or validated protocols with a transfer check for the actual chemistry.

Ordered concentration/time calibration is useful, but buffer/cofactor composition, pH and temperature remain an instruction to establish conditions, without a concrete selection/calibration procedure or executable local settings.

Lists the dimensions that must pass but does not define an acceptable recovery/error/noise criterion or a procedure deriving that criterion before confirmation. An unspecified validated range/pass requirement is incomplete.

Does not specify the unit convention for the primary absolute product-formation rate or reportable product amount/concentration; calibration and blank handling do not supply that missing quantitative endpoint definition.
Describes stopping/redesign but does not require a newly frozen protocol and fresh independent confirmation after changing failed/ambiguous conditions.
Retains useful curves and lots but lacks an auditable raw-file/sample-ID linkage and exact analysis software/code/settings versions sufficient to reconstruct the contrast.

Explicit product-spike, no-target/no-substrate, vehicle active reactions, dark/illumination and reporter-capacity controls have distinct prospective roles. A known inhibitor is appropriately conditional on availability.

Ordered separate-layer checks, validated quench/product recovery and repair/redirection of invalid conditions distinguish multiple failure causes instead of blindly refitting.
